results.title: Assam floods: Over 1.55 lakh affected, death toll rises to 98; damage assessment begins Sunday
results.description: More than 1.55 lakh people remained affected by Assam floods, with the toll in this year’s deluge reaching 98 with one more fatality, officials said on Saturday.

results.title: Pentagon revokes former Air Force chief’s security clearance over Air Force One disclosures
results.description: The Pentagon has revoked former US Air Force Secretary Frank Kendall’s eligibility to access classified information and barred him from holding any sensitive position, accusing him of disclosing classified details about Air Force One to the media

results.title: Tragic Road Accidents in Himachal Pradesh and Punjab Claim 10 Lives
results.description: On Saturday, two tragic road accidents in Himachal Pradesh and Punjab led to the deaths of ten individuals. A bus accident in Chamba claimed seven lives, while a car crash in Jalandhar resulted in three fatalities. Local authorities are investigating the incidents, and rescue operations were promptly initiated. The details surrounding these accidents highlight the urgent need for road safety measures. results.title: Jharkhand Govt Meets Devendra Nath Mahto Over JPSC Paper Leak
results.description: Jharkhand ministers met a student delegation led by Devendra Nath Mahto in Ranchi to resolve protests over alleged JPSC exam paper leaks and demand for a CBI probe.
